lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Intake is beyond the gate. Deliver before closing. Then we discuss upper routes.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: I practiced looking unimpressed. How am I doing?

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: The brake is gone!

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: Aren. That gate will not wait.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Neither will he.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: You understand what you are giving up?

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: It pulls me. Not the whole car.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Try not to be a heavy man, Pell.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: I have been meaning to eat less.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Excellent. Start immediately.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Wrong delivery.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Pell. Unclip. Now.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: Your arm—

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Complain after we land.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: I owe you a delivery.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Make it one that counts.

lettering.speaker: Sera
lettering.text: No stamp. I cannot change that.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: I know. That does not make me less angry.

lettering.speaker: Pell
lettering.text: This is addressed to you. From Lower District.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: That district has been empty for twenty years.

lettering.speaker: Aren
lettering.text: Apparently someone forgot to stop writing.

lettering.speaker: Voice, inside
lettering.text: Little moth. Come inside.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: Oren?

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: You promised never to call me that.

lettering.speaker: Voice
lettering.text: Little moth. Come inside.

lettering.speaker: Neris
lettering.text: Do not answer it.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: A little late for that.

lettering.speaker: Neris
lettering.text: It borrowed my husband first.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: Then it has had practice.

lettering.speaker: Voice
lettering.text: Little moth. Come inside.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: Tell me what you called me after the fire.

lettering.speaker: Voice
lettering.text: Little moth. Come inside.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: I came for a person.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: You only brought me a voice.

lettering.speaker: Neris
lettering.text: Mind the head!

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: I was hoping it did not have one.

lettering.speaker: Neris
lettering.text: It has opinions. Those are worse.

lettering.speaker: Neris
lettering.text: The nursery sent that with yesterday’s planting.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: This was on his coat when he vanished.

lettering.speaker: Neris
lettering.text: Does that mean he is alive?

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: It means someone knows more than a flower.

lettering.speaker: Ilyra
lettering.text: We start with the nursery.

lettering.speaker: Mara
lettering.text: Bring back my signal bell. I will find you a seat.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: A seat? I was negotiating a window.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: You do not even have luggage. What do you need a bell for?

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Both feet down. Then we can discuss it loudly.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Lost my footing. Lost my charge.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: That was a rude amount of discussion.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Oh. You hate the noise.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Your ears. My ride.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Neither of us has to be miserable. Deal?

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Small breath. Small sound.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: I can learn. Occasionally.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: See? A civil conversation.

lettering.speaker: Mara
lettering.text: That is not one of our seats.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: It has a better window.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Tell nobody about this part.

lettering.speaker: Mara
lettering.text: I will need more cloth for that bargain.

lettering.speaker: Mara
lettering.text: Follow us to the first skyport. Then choose your road.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: I like the sound of that. Quietly.

lettering.speaker: Tavi
lettering.text: Next stop: somewhere with lunch.

lettering.speaker: Vexa
lettering.text: Clear the bridge. Earn the key.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: You make it sound as if nobody has tried.

lettering.speaker: Vexa
lettering.text: Borrowed Counter? Did you read the terms?

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: I read the part where it hits back.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: Mine.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: That was considerably more than advertised.

lettering.speaker: Vexa
lettering.text: One hit. Do not ask it for two.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: I only need one good answer.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: Come collect.

lettering.speaker: Vexa
lettering.text: Bridge clear.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: You could try sounding impressed.

lettering.speaker: Vexa
lettering.text: I am. That is why I am worried.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: Temporary?

lettering.speaker: Vexa
lettering.text: The numbness. The debt has other ideas.

lettering.speaker: Vexa
lettering.text: Those gauntlets did not invent that force.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: Then I should probably meet the owner.

lettering.speaker: Ren
lettering.text: After I use the key.

lettering.speaker: Ada
lettering.text: My brother’s coat came back. He did not.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Coats are poor witnesses. Let us find a better one.

lettering.speaker: Ada
lettering.text: He never used the ladder.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: You said that. I should have listened.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Do not move the water.

lettering.speaker: Ada
lettering.text: I was not planning to.

lettering.speaker: Ada
lettering.text: What did you see?

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Your brother opened something. Something noticed.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: You can reach.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: You cannot climb. Good distinction.

lettering.speaker: Ada
lettering.text: Lio! That was his footprint.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Stay here. I have already been wrong once today.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Ada. Take his shoulders.

lettering.speaker: Ada
lettering.text: Then keep that mouth open.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: This is my persuasive face.

lettering.speaker: Lio
lettering.text: They told me the sluice was empty.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Who is they?

lettering.speaker: Lio
lettering.text: Flood Authority. Night shift.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Of course. They used to pay me to call this weather.

lettering.speaker: Corin
lettering.text: Now I send them an invoice.

sequences.title: Nightglass Courier
sequences.premise: A courier seeking admission to the upper routes abandons his qualifying delivery when a glass ray attacks a suspended maintenance lift. His tiny one-line pulling skill saves a stranded worker and earns a dangerous address.
sequences.emotional_engine: Aren wants his skill acknowledged by the city above; under pressure he chooses the work worth being known for, then resents the price rather than smiling away his ambition.
sequences.future_engine: Deliveries into erased districts, rival couriers and glass fauna expose who controls the city routes. Progression comes from stronger anchors, load judgment and increasingly bold blade-assisted maneuvers.

cast.name: Pell
cast.visual: Light-skinned older man with short gray hair, stubble, mustard maintenance jacket and charcoal trousers, broad work harness.
cast.equipment: Harness attached to lift rail until transfer.

cast.name: Glass ray

sequences.chapter_title: A Voice That Knows Your Name
sequences.premise: Ilyra follows her missing brother’s voice into a condemned glasshouse. Its beautiful predator repeats stolen speech; breaking the rooted bloom frees a trapped caretaker but destroys the comforting illusion she came for.
sequences.emotional_engine: Hunger for reunion versus the courage to demand evidence. Ilyra can fight decisively yet remains vulnerable to one familiar sentence.
sequences.future_engine: A trade in cultivated memories leads through haunted estates and impossible gardens. Each case offers a seductive version of a missing person, while Ilyra seeks what actually happened to her brother.

cast.name: Ilyra Sen
cast.visual: Pale adult woman, elegant oval face, gray eyes, smooth chin-length dark brown bob with ivory nape underlayer. Black split-tail coat, high white collar, dark pleated combat trousers, slim boots.
cast.equipment: One silver single-edge saber with open oval black guard in RIGHT hand; silver LEFT forearm guard. Small plain silver clasp at collar.

cast.name: Neris
cast.visual: Light-skinned older female caretaker, long angular nose, gray hair in low knot, plain charcoal dress, faded ivory shawl. Wary and practical.
cast.equipment: Plain iron door key on waist cord; no weapon.

cast.name: Mourning Bloom
cast.visual: Enormous translucent charcoal flower, empty oval center edged with sparse silver thorns, broad dark petals, ONE thick tapering root ending in a single thorn foot. No humanoid mask or hands.
cast.equipment: Heavy petals sweep like broad cutting leaves; root pins a door threshold.

sequences.setting: Abandoned curved-rib glasshouse in pale overcast mist. White entrance at LEFT, small caretaker room with a weight-jammed door at RIGHT; broad matte maroon ground, a few pale fallen petals.
sequences.power_rule: The bloom can replay stolen voices only while its single thick root is planted; it must lift that root to turn its heavy face. Root exposed during a committed petal sweep. Ilyra has ordinary saber skill, no new aura.

sequences.emotional_engine: A proud improviser wants to travel on her own terms. She learns what the opponent wants and turns a losing contest into a deal without becoming meek or giving up her ambition.
sequences.future_engine: Tavi and a stubborn ram cross living weather-country, taking absurd jobs to reach the far skyports. Her grounded wind-pulse technique grows through timing, breath and using terrain creatively.

cast.name: Tavi Ember
cast.visual: Athletic adult woman, broad expressive face, teal eyes, warm light complexion, short curly coral hair swept up with one forward tuft. Turquoise cropped vest over cream top, loose orange fighting trousers, red ankle wraps and cream boots.
cast.equipment: Rounded red gauntlets: anatomical RIGHT has cream circular pressure plate; anatomical LEFT cream crescent. No initial damage. Turquoise cloth padding strip tied around waist over a cream belt; whole strip can be untied and detached.

cast.name: Mara
cast.visual: Light-skinned stocky female caravan captain, silver braid, ochre poncho, dark trousers, stout boots, small blue neck scarf. Amused pragmatist.
cast.equipment: Plain rope halter and caravan tallybook; no weapon.

cast.name: Gale Ram
cast.visual: Living blue cloud-wool ram twice human height, cream muzzle, orange cheeks, curled blue horns, four stout legs and one cloud tail. Broad grouped wool shapes; no armor.
cast.equipment: Plain brass caravan signal bell approximately human-head height, snagged by its strap on near horn; opening broad enough for bulky gauntlets.

sequences.setting: Cream chalk ridge above green windmill hills; wooden caravan platforms and bright cloth sails to LEFT, broad safe grass hollow to RIGHT. A low wooden fence divides paths, with one wide openable gate.
sequences.power_rule: Stored Breath: Tavi charges one short wind pulse in her RIGHT circular gauntlet only while both boots are braced. Losing grounding dissipates any held charge. Release recoils her backward; she cannot recharge airborne. The LEFT crescent glove is defensive.

sequences.title: Red Current
sequences.premise: Ren enters a brutal bridge trial with borrowed gauntlets and wins access to the upper rings by returning a blade-shark’s own strike. His victory is real. So is the debt the weapon writes into his arm.
sequences.emotional_engine: Brash ambition and rivalry: Ren refuses to remain a spectator and is willing to take a frightening shortcut. Winning validates his nerve while exposing the cost he dismissed.
sequences.future_engine: Each higher arena reveals another lender of force. Ren must master what his gauntlets borrow, who collects it and whether victory can free him instead of binding him deeper. Vexa is a rival with reasons to understand that bargain.

style_contract.medium: Black and white directional pen hatching with bold silhouette blacks, athletic angular faces, red gauntlets and localized red impact accents.
style_contract.retain: Kinetic foreshortening, enormous geometric shark shapes, spiral bridge architecture, drawn muscle planes with selective hatch direction.
style_contract.avoid: Glossy gray CGI muscles, shiny vinyl trousers, omnipresent red auras, tiny floor lines and all-over shark swarms.

cast.name: Ren Varr
cast.visual: Light-skinned adult man with angular grin, long black braid from shaved sides, strong athletic build. Sleeveless ivory zip vest with black hood lining, loose black combat trousers, tall black lace-up boots.
cast.equipment: Red armored gauntlets. RIGHT has one broad black central plate that lights red when loaded; LEFT has a plain smooth red back. No initial injury, no initial wrist mark.

cast.name: Vexa Rill
cast.visual: Light-skinned athletic woman, sharp cheekbones, cropped black hair with one white forelock, sleeveless charcoal coat with white collar, black trousers and flat combat boots. Cool competitive gaze.
cast.equipment: Small iron upper-ring entry key on cord; folded spectator permit. She does not fight this pilot.

cast.name: Blade-shark
cast.visual: One giant angular white shark-like aerial predator, black upper fins, dark mouth with large triangular teeth, small red eyes. Bold folded-paper planes and traceable tail/fins, not a collage of many fish.

sequences.setting: Vast looping white concrete bridges above a dark sea. Trial platform at lower ring, high spectator rail beyond. A broad dry circular landing zone, one black boundary stripe, no game HUD.
sequences.power_rule: Borrowed Counter: the RIGHT black-plate gauntlet stores ONE directly blocked physical impact and releases it in ONE punch. It cannot stack charges. The spent arm goes numb and a red debt mark appears around that wrist; the cost is revealed only after the release.
sequences.subtitle: One Hit Owed
sequences.logline: Ren enters a brutal bridge trial with borrowed gauntlets and wins access to the upper rings by returning a blade-shark’s own strike. His victory is real. So is the debt the weapon writes into his arm.

sequences.title: Floodline Detective
sequences.premise: A flood investigator is asked to explain why a missing man’s coat returned without him. A brief still-water memory and an impossible dry footprint lead to a canal predator carrying its victim, and a deliberately opened sluice.
sequences.emotional_engine: Corin hides his responsibility behind wit and skepticism. He starts by treating a witness as mistaken, corrects himself when evidence contradicts him, and earns trust by solving the immediate danger.
sequences.future_engine: Each flooded district contains a supernatural crime with a physical tell. Corin follows whoever routes living predators through municipal infrastructure while his own past in the flood authority complicates every case.

style_contract.medium: Strong black brush masses, scraped white edges and controlled grayscale planes, limited hot-magenta institutional lights. Graphic ink narrative with selective rough marks.
style_contract.retain: Adult face character, monumental flood infrastructure, black umbrella-segment creature and dry wit under genuine threat.
style_contract.avoid: Glossy leather everywhere, repetitive white water sparkles, polished wet mirror floor, decorative ink splatter over clues.

cast.name: Corin Vey
cast.visual: Light-skinned adult man, lean strong build, angular tired face, short black hair with gray temple, faint stubble. Off-white long coat over charcoal high-neck shirt and belted black combat trousers; flat black boots.
cast.equipment: One long straight iron ward-pole with a broad simple solid C-shaped head: upper shoulder can prop an upper jaw while lower curve catches lower lip. No moving mechanism. Held in both hands when fighting. Small plain black notebook kept inside coat.

cast.name: Ada Marr
cast.visual: Light-skinned adult woman with short blunt blond hair, blunt expressive face, dark hooded rain cape over gray knit top, pale practical trousers and black boots. Direct, angry sister.
cast.equipment: Her missing brother’s dark work coat folded over one arm.

cast.name: Lio Marr
cast.visual: Light-skinned adult man, short dark hair, narrow face, pale rolled-sleeve work shirt, dark trousers, plain boots. Unconscious when first physically seen, then breathing and shaken.
cast.equipment: Small brass municipal sluice key on a cord at neck.

cast.name: Umbrella eel
cast.visual: One thick black segmented canal creature with overlapping umbrella-like membrane ribs, tapering body and broad hinged pale mouth. Two large readable gripping jaws, no human limbs.
cast.equipment: Its wet body moves through connected water; it cannot propel its full weight across the dry high ledge.

sequences.setting: Monumental concrete floodworks. Dry elevated inspection ledge on LEFT, black canal two meters below RIGHT; one broad spillway gap and a tall locked sluice with a magenta signal panel. Water uses large black/white shape groups.
sequences.power_rule: Stillwater Witness: touching an undisturbed pool with two bare fingertips shows ONE brief visual imprint of the last person it reflected. Any ripple erases the imprint. It does not identify motives or predict events. The creature’s dry-ledge limitation is observed physical behavior, not a second detective power.
sequences.subtitle: The Coat That Walked Home
sequences.logline: A flood investigator is asked to explain why a missing man’s coat returned without him. A brief still-water memory and an impossible dry footprint lead to a canal predator carrying its victim, and a deliberately opened sluice.

chapters.logline: Tavi tries to recover a caravan’s stolen signal bell from an enormous wind-breathing ram. A brief disastrous contest reveals that the ram wants relief from the painful clang, not treasure, and Tavi negotiates an unconventional ride.

chapters.title: Red Current
chapters.premise: Ren enters a brutal bridge trial with borrowed gauntlets and wins access to the upper rings by returning a blade-shark’s own strike. His victory is real. So is the debt the weapon writes into his arm.
chapters.emotional_engine: Brash ambition and rivalry: Ren refuses to remain a spectator and is willing to take a frightening shortcut. Winning validates his nerve while exposing the cost he dismissed.
chapters.future_engine: Each higher arena reveals another lender of force. Ren must master what his gauntlets borrow, who collects it and whether victory can free him instead of binding him deeper. Vexa is a rival with reasons to understand that bargain.

chapters.title: Floodline Detective
chapters.premise: A flood investigator is asked to explain why a missing man’s coat returned without him. A brief still-water memory and an impossible dry footprint lead to a canal predator carrying its victim, and a deliberately opened sluice.
chapters.emotional_engine: Corin hides his responsibility behind wit and skepticism. He starts by treating a witness as mistaken, corrects himself when evidence contradicts him, and earns trust by solving the immediate danger.
chapters.future_engine: Each flooded district contains a supernatural crime with a physical tell. Corin follows whoever routes living predators through municipal infrastructure while his own past in the flood authority complicates every case.
